description.value: Sweet Revenge Bakery is a woman-owned bakery-cafe in Surrey, BC, founded by pastry chef Ally Han whose family also runs Maria's Gelato in Fort Langley. The cafe serves an extensive espresso and tea menu alongside freshly baked goods, house-made gelato, and custom cakes, all made in-store daily. It positions itself as a welcoming community gathering space, making it a comfortable stop for cyclists passing through the 64th Ave corridor.
